topic_zh: McGuire NeighborMax 速度分块扩张运动模糊对比中心像素速度查表外轮廓剪断
scope: Deterministic Morgan McGuire et al. No neural frame interpolation execution.

Neural optical-flow video frame interpolation (RIFE / DLSS 3 Frame Generation)
